entries.5a2f6a210b776039: In 2005 it completed the world's first new plant compatible with 8th-generation panels, and in 2008 it completed the Shiga Plant, the world's first to support 10th- and 11th-generation panels; in 2009 it began production and shipment of photomasks for 10th-generation panels, and it has a track record of establishing a production system for larger-generation photomasks early. Production is carried out at the Kyoto Plant, the Shiga Plant, and a subsidiary in Taiwan.
entries.5d84dcab7993b735: Its basic management philosophy is “Creation and Harmony,” and its purpose is “to contribute to society through the power of electronics and technology.” As issues to address, it plans to pursue four items: growth investment to improve earnings capacity in the existing photomask business; expanding the earnings base through launching new businesses (expanding sales of RFID and healthcare products, developing new proprietary products, and considering M&A); improving group strength through affiliated subsidiaries; and strengthening the management foundation that supports sustainable growth.

entries.ab6b3c979137ce59: Of revenue of ¥29,187 million for the fiscal year ended September 2025, the large photomask business accounted for ¥28,776 million, so revenue is highly concentrated in this business. The screen mask and metal mask business (¥326 million) and the solutions business (¥84 million), added in the fiscal year ended September 2025, are currently small in scale.
entries.b04ed4d0b7f7ef74: The core business designs, manufactures and sells large photomasks, which are the master plates required for manufacturing liquid crystal panels and organic EL panels. Photomasks are master plates used to transfer the patterns of control circuits and color filters for liquid crystals and organic EL onto substrates. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥28,776 million. Production is handled by the Kyoto Plant, the Shiga Plant and Taiwan's Dingzheng Technology Co., Ltd., and sales are handled by subsidiaries in China and Korea.
entries.b2a85aa66e142c09: Added as a reportable segment following the acquisition of all shares of Asahi Tech Co., Ltd. in the fiscal year ended September 2025, when it became a consolidated subsidiary. It manufactures screen masks used in the printing process for automotive glass and electronic components, and metal masks used in the solder paste printing process for semiconductor packages and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥326 million.
